title: August and the Blue Hour
author: Sebastian Thornbury
blurb: Rafael Quintana, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has spent twelve years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
